content:
August has arrived, with $50 off AirPods Pro 3, $100 off AirPods Max 2, and ongoing all-time low deals on AirTag 2 still in effect. But today's 9to5Toys "Morning Delivery" spotlight is on the M5 MacBook Air — we spotted a rare $200 discount on the 24GB/512GB model, while the official Apple Certified Refurbished store also has select configurations marked down by up to $300, including this 24GB 15-inch model (more on that here). Also on tap today: nearly $100 off various Apple Watch Ultra 3 configurations, the latest Beats 240W Woven USB-C Cable (Black) down at just $18, and a chance to score transparent red Beats Solo Buds for as low as $40. Read on for details.

August AirPods deals from $99: AirPods Pro 3, Max 2, and more marked down by up to $100

  • AirPods Pro 3 $200 (orig. $249)
  • AirPods Max 2 $449 (orig. $549)
  • AirPods 4 $99 (orig. $129)
  • AirPods 4 with Active Noise Cancellation $119 (orig. $179 new) — Renewed Premium

Best Buy launches August back-to-school deals: Apple gear, smart TVs from $80, dorm upgrades, and more

Apple's official refurbished store now has the lowest prices on M5 MacBook Air with up to $300 off

The latest MacBook lineup price hikes have already taken effect at retail, and although we've tracked plenty of deals with up to $500 off, the official Apple Certified Refurbished store offering discounts on select M5 MacBook Air configurations is among the most compelling options out there. We previously featured the lowest-price base model from a reputable seller, but you can now also score the 24GB 15-inch model in Midnight, Silver, Starlight, and Sky Blue for $300 off the new retail price.

Apple's official refurbished store is now selling the 15-inch M5 MacBook Pro with 24GB RAM and 1TB storage for $1,699 shipped. As mentioned above, this deal applies to all four colors: Midnight, Silver, Starlight, and Sky Blue.

This MacBook Air originally priced at $1,900 is now going for over $1,999 across all configurations at Amazon.

  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/512GB $1,099 (orig. $1,299 new) — $200 off
  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/1TB $1,359 (orig. $1,599 new) — $240 off
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 24GB/1TB $1,699 (orig. $1,999 new) — $300 off

Today's Apple refurbished deal brings this machine back to its previous pricing with the best discount we've tracked since the price increase took effect. As things stand, these new MSRPs are very likely to hold through the end of the year and possibly beyond. So while this isn't the lowest price ever, it's definitely a noteworthy money-saving opportunity for anyone looking to pick up an M5 MacBook Air this year — the next MacBook Air lineup likely won't see these prices until 2027.

Browse all MacBook deals at Apple's refurbished store — use the filters on the left side of the page to select your desired model.

The best-price 15-inch 24GB M5 MacBook Air is now $200 off

Still live: 2TB M5 Pro MacBook Pro marked down by $500 today at Amazon

MacBook prices have indeed just gone up, but Amazon is still offering a massive $500 discount on the 24GB/2TB M5 Pro MacBook Pro this morning. This price is very close to the lowest we've tracked before the price increase took effect. Details below.

Amazon is now selling the 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro with 24GB RAM and 2TB storage for $2,499 shipped.

Considering this machine regularly goes for $2,999 at Apple and elsewhere, you're now saving $500 — a substantial discount. This deal applies to both Space Black and Silver models.

Since major retailers raised prices, this is the best discount we've tracked on an M5 Pro configuration.

Before today, Amazon's highest discount on this machine was $300, but now it's been marked down by an additional $200.

Although it hasn't quite reached the price we tracked before the official price increase — which is beyond our control and can't be undone — and considering all factors, remember this machine was just marked up about a month ago. This discount is only $100 away from the lowest price we've ever tracked for the M5 Pro.

Black and Natural Titanium Apple Watch Ultra 3 models now nearly $100 off at Amazon

Update: As expected, Amazon has now also lowered prices on several other Ultra 3 configurations, including the Natural Titanium case with the Anchor Blue Ocean band, marked down by nearly $100. Details below.

While the Series 11 lineup has seen steady discounts — like the situation as August kicks off — deals on the Apple Watch Ultra 3 have been relatively rare. But this morning we spotted the black Ultra 3 with the Black Ocean band (basically a universal fit) marked down by nearly $100 at Amazon.

Amazon is now selling the black titanium Apple Watch Ultra 3 with the Black Ocean band for $699.99 shipped.

This machine originally priced at $799 is now nearly $100 off, making it the best discount we've found from reputable retailers on brand-new units.

Aside from the brief $150 discount during Amazon Prime Day, this price matches the best deals we've seen this year and represents one of the few significant discount opportunities on Amazon.

As of writing, the black model with the Ocean band is the only configuration enjoying a substantial discount. But if this discount follows the same pattern as last time, there's a good chance we'll see more color configurations marked down today and throughout the week.

  • Black Apple Watch Ultra 3 with Black Ocean band $700 (orig. $799)
  • Natural Titanium Apple Watch Ultra 3 with Anchor Blue Ocean band $700 (orig. $799)
  • Natural Titanium Apple Watch Ultra 3 with Blue Trail Loop band $700 (orig. $799)
  • Natural Titanium Apple Watch Ultra 3 with Milanese Loop $800 (orig. $899)

If what you're after is the Series 11, you can now pick one up for much less:

  • 42mm Apple Watch Series 11 $299 (orig. $399)
  • 46mm Apple Watch Series 11 $329 (orig. $429)

The latest Beats 240W Woven USB-C Cable (Black) drops back to all-time low $18 shipped for Prime members (40% off)

Transparent red Beats Solo Buds available for as low as $41 today

We were very impressed with the Solo Buds' built-in battery life — it's the most affordable new-generation Beats wireless earbuds you can buy right now. But priced at $80 and frequently going for $70 at Amazon, they become even more attractive when you can grab them for $41 shipped at Best Buy. Browse all Best Buy Beats deals, then read on for more details about the Solo Buds below.

Best Buy is now selling open-box Beats Solo Buds in transparent red in "excellent condition" for $40.99 shipped. That's nearly 50% off the original price, well below Amazon's $70 new-unit pricing.

  • Functions and appearance like new.
  • Includes all components and accessories. Packaging may vary or come without packaging.

What you're looking at is indeed a more entry-level earbud, but what we're seeing is a new-generation earbud from an Apple-owned brand at just $41.

As mentioned above, in our hands-on testing, the earbuds' built-in battery can actually deliver up to 18 hours of listening time on a single charge. Although it doesn't come with a battery-equipped wireless charging case, for most users this battery life is more than adequate — especially at just $41. Other features include one-touch pairing, custom microphones with "advanced noise reduction algorithms for superior call quality," and industry-leading Class 1 Bluetooth.
